explanation.text: The Constitution was signed in September 1787 and the Bill of Rights was ratified in December 1791, a span of over four years. The Bill of Rights was proposed to Congress in June 1789 (and approved in September 1789) and ratified in December 1791, a span of about two years. Thus the first interval exceeds the second, confirming the claim.
